issues.title: This Week in Plasma: Emoji On-Screen Keyboard
issues.html:
Welcome to a new issue of This Week in Plasma!

This week saw many new features and user interface improvements! Plasma 6.9 is coming together, and promises a lot of great stuff. Meanwhile, we didn’t let up on the bug fixes or performance improvements, either. Check it out:

Notable new features

Plasma 6.9

Plasma’s on-screen keyboard now features an emoji input mode! (Devin Lin, plasma-keyboard MR #189)

Mobile
Desktop

The Bluetooth widget now shows separate battery levels for Bluetooth devices with multiple batteries, like wireless earbuds with a charging case containing a third battery. (Matthias Kurz, bluedevil MR #261)

If you’re using the features on System Settings’ Touchpad page to disable a touchpad after typing or interacting with a trackpoint, now it lets you configure how long the touchpad gets disabled for. (Ken Bloom, KDE Bugzilla #518362)

System Settings’ Mouse page now lets you configure a mouse with its movement axis rotated, which can be useful for mouse-style devices held and used at an angle. (Matthias Berndt, plasma-desktop MR #4123)

Notable UI improvements

Plasma 6.8.4

Dragging an app to a Task Manager widget now positions it in the place where it was dropped, rather than always at the end. (Christoph Wolk, plasma-desktop MR #4259)

Plasma 6.9

The context menu for desktop folders now includes a “Create New” item, just like it does in Dolphin. (Aliaksei Kutniak, KDE Bugzilla #451215)

The screen chooser OSD that appears when you plug in a new screen or press Meta+P now shows more sensible options for setups with three or more screens. (Tobias Fella, KDE Bugzilla #421032)

System Settings’ File Associations page has been ported to Qt Quick and modernized. (Tobias Fella, kde-cli-tools MR #142)

The “Peek at Desktop” effect now sends windows into their closest screen corners. (Frederic Liang, kwin MR #10464)

The settings for how to scale apps using XWayland on a high-DPI screen have been moved to System Settings’ “Legacy X11 App Support” page. (Kai Uwe Broulik, kwin MR #10462 and kscreen MR #537)

Frameworks 6.33

Kirigami-based apps and windows throughout Plasma and KDE apps now allow window backgrounds to be fully themed according to the active style. (Filip Fila, kirigami MR #2241)

Notable bug fixes

Plasma 6.6.8

Fixed a bug that could cause Plasma to unnecessarily consume CPU resources if you opened the Networks widget’s popup and then closed it while it was in the middle of refreshing networks. (Michal Malinowski, libplasma MR #1639)

Plasma 6.8.4

Fixed a case where KWin could crash while logging in when screens with very specific characteristics were connected. (Xaver Hugl, KDE Bugzilla #529143)

Fixed a bug that made screens get stuck in a dimmed state if they were disconnected while the computer was asleep, and then reconnected after it woke up. (Petru Mare, KDE Bugzilla #513809)

Fixed two issues with keys used for Discord’s push-to-talk feature not working as expected. (Milosz Jakubczyk and Łukasz Patron, KDE Bugzilla #484525 and KDE Bugzilla #521565)

Fixed a bug that prevented the Task Manager widget from updating itself as expected following screen-related changes while using its “Show only tasks: From the current screen” setting. (Ivan Tkachenko, KDE Bugzilla #520961)

Fixed a bug that prevented the names of network folders from appearing properly in the history views of the Kicker/Kickoff/Dashboard/etc. widgets. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #516894)

When using a mixed dark/light Plasma style like Breeze Twilight, panel icon previews are no longer invisible in the configuration dialog of the Kicker and Kickoff widgets. (Peder Bergan, KDE Bugzilla #525301)

Fixed a bug that sometimes prevented the system’s global IPv6 address from appearing in the Networks widget. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #509743)

Fixed an issue that made System Settings’ Game Controller page not indicate the correct buttons on controllers with unusual implementations of their button layouts. (Carlos Lawrence, plasma-desktop MR #4234)

Plasma 6.9

On an operating system that uses the PackageKit library’s “Offline Updates” feature, when such an update that was started from Discover fails, the “Repair” button on the notification telling you about this state of affairs now actually works! (Taras Oleksyn, KDE Bugzilla #528925)

Fixed a bug that would eventually make KRunner crash over and over if you (or more likely, your cat or toddler) repeatedly entered text into it for a very long time. (Kai Uwe Broulik, KDE Bugzilla #529396)

Frameworks 6.33

If you happen to have a custom widget that’s a symlink to another one, deleting the widget now deletes the symlink rather than its target. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #508717)

When for some reason a KRunner-powered search produces a search result that’s incredibly long, it now shortens the text automatically so it can’t make the UI freeze. (Farhad Hedayatifard, krunner MR #232)

Notable in performance & technical

Plasma 6.8.4

Worked around an Intel graphics driver bug that sometimes made screens flicker. (Xaver Hugl, kwin MR #10501)

Fixed a case where KWin could briefly freeze when an app using XWayland showed a tooltip while being run in a container with a hostname different from that of the host system. (Peder Bergan, KDE Bugzilla #523909)

The Wobbly Windows effect no longer makes windows wobble differently based on the refresh rate of the screen they’re on. (Vlad Zahorodnii, KDE Bugzilla #525465)

Plasma 6.9

Discover is now faster to show apps on operating systems that use the PackageKit library. (Aleix Pol Gonzalez, discover MR #1495)

How you can help

Help KDE throughout 2027 by donating to our end-of-year fundraiser! So far you’ve helped us raise 57% of our goal, but we’re not there yet. If you can, make a donation today!

Beyond that, you can help KDE by directly getting involved in any other projects. Donating time is actually more impactful than donating money. Each contributor makes a huge difference in KDE — you are not a number or a cog in a machine! You don’t have to be a programmer, either; many other opportunities exist.

To get a new Plasma feature or a bug fix mentioned here

Push a commit to the relevant merge request on invent.kde.org.

issues.title: This Week in Plasma: CJK Text Input and Performance
issues.html:
Welcome to a new issue of This Week in Plasma!

Notable new features

Plasma 6.9

Plasma’s on-screen keyboard now includes various text composers for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. (Devin Lin, plasma-keyboard MR #113)

You can now control the rate at which the text insertion point blinks throughout most apps, or make it stop blinking entirely. (Alexander Berg, KDE Bugzilla #343635)

The Kicker Application Menu widget now supports showing a text label alongside the icon, just like Kickoff does. (小太, KDE Bugzilla #456252)

Notable UI improvements

Plasma 6.8.4

KRunner’s window is no longer so flickery and jumpy as it grows and shrinks. (Victor Prudniy, KDE Bugzilla #513950)

The Networks widget no longer offers you the opportunity to connect to a Wi-Fi network via a QR code on systems with no Wi-Fi adapters. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #517252)

It’s now possible to play or pause media on the lock screen using a device that sends explicit “play” or “pause” signals, not just the combined “play/pause” toggle. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #500388)

The Kickoff Application Launcher widget now displays more standard behavior for the highlighting applied to its grid items after you right-click them. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #505920)

Plasma 6.9

On a multi-screen setup, right-clicking the desktop and choosing “Display Configuration” now opens the relevant System Settings page showing the screen with the desktop you right-clicked. (Kai Uwe Broulik and Joshua Goins, kscreen MR #522)

System Settings’ Accessibility page now includes convenient links to pages where you can change the display scale or font sizes. (Alexander Berg, KDE Bugzilla #462501)

System Settings’ Font Management page has been transformed into a standalone app. It seemed to fit better that way, and this reduces the clutter in System Settings. (Tobias Fella, plasma-workspace MR #7395)

The indicator highlight for panel widgets with a popup open is now sized in the same way that it is for System Tray widgets, improving consistency. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #522844)

Synchronizing your Plasma desktop settings to Plasma Login Manager now includes your Night Light settings, too. (Anton Birkel, KDE Bugzilla #521408)

Notable bug fixes

Plasma 6.6.8

Deleting a panel now deletes any global shortcuts that had been assigned to its widgets, preventing them from forever cluttering up System Settings’ Shortcuts page and your Plasma config file. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #410903)

The Web Browser widget’s custom home page setting now works. (Christoph Wolk, kdeplasma-addons MR #1286)

Fixed a bug that prevented connecting to an OpenConnect VPN with authentication group names in Chinese. (Zheng Ender, plasma-nm MR #698)

Plasma 6.8.4

Fixed a recent regression that made KWin crash at login on certain systems. (Xaver Hugl, KDE Bugzilla #528824)

Fixed a case where KWin could crash after a GPU reset. (Xaver Hugl, kwin MR #10349)

Fixed a case where Plasma could crash when you unplugged a removable USB disk very quickly after telling Plasma to safely eject it. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #526537)

Fixed a case where Plasma could crash when you removed a Weather Report widget. (Bohdan Onofriichuk, KDE Bugzilla #528997)

Fixed a case where notifications about your battery being critically low could pile up after waking the computer. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #520491)

When Plasma is woken up due to certain kinds of background network and Bluetooth activity, now it goes to sleep again afterwards. (Michael Auer, powerdevil MR #706)

Fixed a case where Discover would fail to install local package files (e.g. .rpm or .deb files) when the PackageKit daemon wasn’t already running. (Taras Oleksyn, KDE Bugzilla #528037)

The “Horizontal Bars” display style for System Monitor sensors now looks correct when using a left-to-right language like Arabic or Hebrew. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #523137)

Pressing keys on your keyboard’s numberpad no longer activates KRunner when they aren’t supposed to. (Alan Witkowski, KDE Bugzilla #528338)

Deleting a super duper thick panel no longer visually breaks Plasma’s edit mode. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #525374)

Plasma 6.9

Plasma no longer freezes if you try to add more widgets to the desktop when it’s already completely full. (Marco Martin, KDE Bugzilla #528989)

Support for auto-mounting only specific disks now works reliably, by storing the ID of each disk in a way that’s persistent over time. (Tobias Fella, KDE Bugzilla #458349)

The Task Manager now shows the icons of web apps more reliably. (Nicolas Fella, KDE Bugzilla #447845)

Fixed an issue that made the labels of items on the desktop blurry at certain screen scale factors. (Ramil Nurmanov and Anton Birkel, libplasma MR #1606)

Spectacle’s “Use last-used capture mode” setting now works again. (Mohanraj Velayutham, KDE Bugzilla #508488)

The keyboard shortcut used to show and hide Yakuake now works on Wayland when using the app’s “Use Open/Retract action to focus window” setting. (Albert Vaca Cintora, KDE Bugzilla #402634)

Notable in performance & technical

Plasma 6.6.8

Fixed a memory leak in System Settings’ Display Configuration page. (Stefan Zabka, kscreen MR #533)

Plasma 6.8.4

KWin now works around a kernel issue that can cause visual stutters when opening and closing windows on some systems. (Vlad Zahorodnii, KDE Bugzilla #523813)

Plasma 6.9

Spectacle is now even faster to take screenshots. And not just Spectacle, but all software using KWin’s screenshot plugin. You can read more about it on Kai’s blog. (Vlad Zahorodnii and Kai Uwe Broulik, kwin MR #10307, spectacle MR #632)

KWin now uses overlay planes for NVIDIA GPUs using driver version 615.78.08 or later, which should reduce energy usage. (Jakub Okoński, kwin MR #10398)

When a third-party plugin is making KWin crash repeatedly, now it stops after two crashes and unloads those plugins. (Alexander Berg, kwin MR #10283)

Plasma no longer invokes its animated image support for images capable of animation but containing only a single frame, which saves some resources. (Viesturs Zarins, plasma-workspace MR #7418)

Plasma Login Manager no longer shows sessions that are supposed to be hidden. (Alexander Berg, KDE Bugzilla #525584)

KWin’s screenshot and color picker plugins have been ported away from direct OpenGL usage, paving the way for a Vulkan future. (Xaver Hugl, kwin MR #10355 and kwin MR #10393)

Plasma Desktop’s session files now live in the plasma-desktop repository/package, so they won’t be inappropriately shown to people using Plasma Mobile. (Peder Bergan, plasma-workspace work item #173)

Frameworks 6.33

KDE’s icon loader now makes use of the GTK icon cache if it’s present, which slightly speeds up icon loading in all KDE software, and all Qt-based software run in Plasma. (Chinmoy Pradhan, kiconthemes MR #222)

How you can help

KDE has become important in the world, and your time and contributions have helped us get there. As we grow, we need your support to keep KDE sustainable.

One of the best ways right now is to donate to KDE’s fundraiser. We’re halfway to our 2026 goal, and I think we can get all the way there! Your donations will help support the two open positions, as well as hopefully more in the future. So consider making a donation today!

Beyond that, you can help KDE by directly getting involved in any other projects. Donating time can actually be more impactful than donating money. Each contributor makes a huge difference in KDE — you are not a number or a cog in a machine! You don’t have to be a programmer, either; many other opportunities exist.

You can also help out by making a donation! This helps cover operational costs, salaries, travel expenses for contributors, and in general just keeps KDE bringing Free Software to the world.

To get a new Plasma feature or a bug fix mentioned here

Push a commit to the relevant merge request on invent.kde.org.

issues.title: This Week in Plasma: XWayland On Demand
issues.html:
Welcome to a new issue of This Week in Plasma!

This week a significant technical milestone was achieved: the XWayland compatibility layer is now loaded only when needed. Previously it had always been running even when no apps were using it, and fixing this required porting various system services away from legacy X11 code paths. This work was done by Vlad Zahorodnii, David Edmundson, and David Redondo, and will ship in Plasma 6.9.

But that wasn’t all, not by a long shot! Check it out here:

Notable new features

Plasma 6.9

You can now quickly forget networks from the Networks widget, not just its associated page in System Settings. (Peder Bergan, KDE Bugzilla #525852)

The System Monitor app and widgets now include a sensor that lists the number of physical CPU cores. (Méven Car, ksystemstats MR #157)

Notable UI improvements

Plasma 6.9

System Settings’s Task Switching page has been ported to QML, with a substantially improved UI and the Overview effect’s settings included. (Oliver Beard and Tobias Fella, kwin MR #7604)

" lazy class="rounded">
" lazy class="rounded">

System Settings’ Date & Time page has also been ported to QML, with a simplified single-page design that makes it faster to change the time zone when needed. (James Graham and David Edmundson, plasma-desktop MR #3653 and plasma-workspace MR #6884)

The desktop wallpaper configuration page now reserves more space for wallpapers, thanks to moving the combobox used for selecting the desktop type over to the “Layout” page. (Ramil Nurmanov, plasma-desktop MR #4113 and plasma-workspace MR #7294)

New
Old

The Folder View widget and desktop icons now give you more size options, filling in a huge size gap between the largest size and the size right before it. (Nathan Heller, KDE Bugzilla #521201)

Spectacle’s darkened overlay now fades in and out. (Kai Uwe Broulik, spectacle MR #624 and kwin MR #10360)

When a grouped Task Manager task is flashing to get your attention, opening its group popup now reveals which specific window wanted attention. (Christoph Wolk, plasma-desktop MR #4225)

The Timer widget now lets you change a timer’s duration in the conventional way, without having to scroll over it. This also fixes some theming-related glitches. (Christoph Wolk, kdeplasma-addons MR #1251 and KDE Bugzilla #522797)

When using the Media Frame widget to show only a single image, it no longer cross-fades between that image and itself. (Christoph Wolk, KDE Bugzilla #518053)

The Comic Strip and Media Frame widgets now use consistent floating toolbars for their “Previous” and “Next” buttons, improving visual consistency and Fitts’ law adherence. (Christoph Wolk, kdeplasma-addons MR #1236 and kdeplasma-addons MR #1238)

System Settings’ Keyboard page no longer lets you toggle custom layouts on or off; it assumes that you want to use the system-wide keyboard settings until you add some custom ones, and now it clearly informs you of this. (Tobias Fella, plasma-desktop MR #3825)

Breeze-styled sliders now have nicer-looking tickmarks when using a fractional scale factor. (Eike Hein, breeze MR #649)

Plasma’s network share setup wizard is now more intelligent about populating its settings fields with information from a pasted URL, including the network protocol and whether the connection should be encrypted or not. (Méven Car, plasma-desktop MR #4216)

Job transfer notifications now show a prettier representation of the destination in cases where the destination is a special URL like desktop:/ or trash:/. (Tobias Fella, plasma-workspace MR #7391)

The Media Controller widget no longer shows tickmarks on its playback slider for media shorter than a minute in length. (Christoph Wolk and Yuma Kakei, plasma-workspace MR #7260 and libplasma MR #1608)

The Wobbly Windows effect (which you should absolutely be using) now includes some fun named presets for different levels of wobbliness. (Antti Savolainen, kwin MR #10308)

Frameworks 6.33

Throughout Plasma and Kirigami-based KDE apps, buttons that show text will no longer ever display a hover tooltip with the same text, because that’s silly. (Kai Uwe Broulik, kirigami MR #2232)

Qt 6.13

Focusing a QtWidgets-based KDE app by clicking on its hamburger menu button now changes all of the window’s colors to their focused versions, rather than only after the menu was closed. (Kai Uwe Broulik, KDE Bugzilla #452212)

Notable bug fixes

Plasma 6.6.8

The Task Manager widget’s textual list popup now looks correct when using a right-to-left language like Arabic or Hebrew. (Christoph Wolk, plasma-desktop MR #4197)

Fixed an issue that made pointers look a bit jagged in screencasts taken on screens using fractional scaling. (Anton Lisovskiy, KDE Bugzilla #528423)

Fixed an issue that made the Color Picker widget sometimes draw a contrast circle around saved colors at inappropriate times. (Christoph Wolk, kdeplasma-addons MR #1253)

Plasma 6.7.7

Fixed an issue in the Color Picker widget that prevented middle-clicking on a preview from copying the color to the clipboard. (Christoph Wolk, kdeplasma-addons MR #1254)

Plasma 6.8.3

Fixed a case that could make the screen locker crash (without unlocking the system, so there was no security issue) in certain cases when a screen was disconnected while the system was sleeping. (Drew, KDE Bugzilla #528438)

Fixed a case where System Settings could crash when the Wallpaper page was open and a screen was disconnected. (Nikolai Nyegaard, KDE Bugzilla #528380)

Fixed a recent regression that caused visual corruption on certain systems with Intel CPUs and NVIDIA GPUs. (Xaver Hugl, KDE Bugzilla #527163)

Fixed a recent regression that made the systemwide color picker fail to include a picked color’s alpha channel. (Jean-Baptiste Mardelle, KDE Bugzilla #528396)

Fixed a visual glitch on System Settings’ Color Scheme page that made some previews visually overflow. (Akseli Lahtinen, KDE Bugzilla #528106)

Fixed a subtle issue that caused inappropriate default scale factors to be chosen for some laptops and handheld gaming consoles. (Xaver Hugl, kwin MR #10327)

Global Themes once again correctly apply non-default font settings. (Alexander Berg, plasma-workspace MR #7340)

Plasma 6.8.4

Hardened KWin against crashing when a game like Elden Ring sent it invalid HDR data. (Xaver Hugl, KDE Bugzilla #528428)

Fixed a case where Discover could crash when you asked it to trash the orphaned data of an uninstalled Flatpak app whose runtime had also been uninstalled. (David Edmundson, KDE Bugzilla #528572)

Fixed a somewhat common way that Discover could crash on operating systems using its RPM-OSTree backend, including Fedora Kinoite and Bazzite. (Aleix Pol Gonzalez, discover MR #1445)

Fixed an issue that would make Plasma freeze if you put the Window List widget into a vertical panel wider than 144 pixels. (Christoph Wolk, KDE Bugzilla #527314)

Fixed a regression that could make certain fullscreen windows visually freeze when screen tearing was allowed and atomic modesetting was disabled. (Xaver Hugl, KDE Bugzilla #528579)

Fixed a regression that made it impossible to drag files and folders on the desktop across screens if their filenames contained URLs. (Akseli Lahtinen, plasma-desktop MR #4205)

Fixed a regression that made the “Add Widgets” sidebar sometimes open on the wrong screen of a multi-screen setup. (Niccolò Venerandi, KDE Bugzilla #528201)

Copying text on Info Center’s “About” page that you selected with the pointer now copies just that text, and the little message that tells you about it is now correct, too. (Tobias Fella, kinfocenter MR #324)

Plasma 6.9

The Plasma Browser Integration plugin no longer breaks the ability to share your screen using Microsoft Teams. (Kanishk Ranjan, KDE Bugzilla #507991)

Using an Alternate Calendar plugin in the Digital Clock widget no longer forces its events panel to appear when it would otherwise remain disabled. (Tobias Fella, KDE Bugzilla #497122)

Notable in performance & technical

Plasma 6.9

Spectacle is now even faster to launch, thanks to further optimizations and parallelizations. (Kai Uwe Broulik, spectacle MR #625 and spectacle MR #626)

The “Add Widgets” sidebar is now substantially faster to open, with a smoother animation, too. (Kai Uwe Broulik, plasma-desktop MR #4224 and plasma-workspace MR #7398)

Window thumbnails in the Task Manager widget no longer wastefully regenerate themselves when the pointer leaves them and returns, avoiding some unnecessary work and fixing a slight visual flicker. (Christoph Wolk, libplasma MR #1629)

If you’re using Plasma Login Manager as your login manager/greeter and it breaks for whatever reason, now it includes a simple fallback that at least gets you to a terminal, rather than stranding you at a black screen. (Harald Sitter, plasma-login-manager MR #232)

How you can help

KDE has become important in the world, and your time and contributions have helped us get there. As we grow, we need your support to keep KDE sustainable.

Donate to KDE’s current fundraiser! We’ve raised 42% of the funds we need to be in a better position for next year, so every little bit helps!

Beyond that, you can help KDE by directly getting involved in any other projects. Donating time is actually more impactful than donating money. Each contributor makes a huge difference in KDE — you are not a number or a cog in a machine! You don’t have to be a programmer, either; many other opportunities exist.

You can also help out by making a donation! This helps cover operational costs, salaries, travel expenses for contributors, and in general just keeps KDE bringing Free Software to the world.

To get a new Plasma feature or a bug fix mentioned here

Push a commit to the relevant merge request on invent.kde.org.
